filter.noneStaged: No staged files match the filter.

clean.title: Working tree clean
clean.description: Nothing to commit. Edits you make show up here.

ai.label: Generate message
ai.needProvider: Configure an AI provider in Settings first.

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.hint: Resolve each file, then commit to finish the {{operation}}.

changes.title: Changes
changes.discardAllDescription: Every unstaged change will be reverted and untracked files will be deleted. This cannot be undone — not even with {{mod}}Z.

staged.title: Staged
staged.discardAllDescription: Every staged file goes back to the last commit, unstaged edits to those files included, and new files are deleted. This cannot be undone — not even with {{mod}}Z.
staged.emptyDescription: Tick a file above, or Stage all, to put it in the next commit.

discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.descStagedNew: This file is new — discarding removes it from the index and deletes the file. This cannot be undone.
discard.descStaged: The file goes back to the last commit — its staged and unstaged changes are both reverted. This cannot be undone.
discard.descUntracked: This file is new — discarding reverts it and deletes the file. This cannot be undone.
discard.descUnstaged: All changes in this file will be reverted. This cannot be undone.
discard.descManyStaged: These files go back to the last commit — staged and unstaged changes alike. New files are deleted. This cannot be undone.
discard.descManyUnstaged: All changes in these files will be reverted. Untracked files among them are deleted. This cannot be undone.
discard.submodule: "{{path}}" is a submodule — open it as its own repository to discard the changes inside it.
discard.leftoverFile: Could not discard "{{path}}" — the change is still present.
discard.leftoverSub_one: {{count}} change could not be discarded — {{submodules}} of it is a submodule. Open it as its own repository to discard the changes inside it: {{listed}}
discard.leftoverSub_other: {{count}} changes could not be discarded — {{submodules}} of them are submodules. Open them as their own repositories to discard the changes inside: {{listed}}
discard.stagedLeftover_one: {{count}} staged change could not be discarded: {{listed}}
discard.stagedLeftover_other: {{count}} staged changes could not be discarded: {{listed}}
discard.removeUntracked: The file is untracked — deleting it cannot be undone.
discard.removeTracked: The file will be removed from your working tree. It can be restored with Discard (the deletion shows as a change).

commit.summaryPlaceholderAmend: New summary (leave empty to keep current)
commit.resizeTitle: Drag to resize · double-click to reset
commit.abortHint: Reset the working copy to the state before the merge started
commit.abortDescription: The merge will be aborted and the working copy reset to the state before it started. This cannot be undone.
